jobs.description:
Our client is an established international professional services organization.

Jobomschrijving

• Map and document end-to-end processes across the different Business Services functions.
• Meet with key stakeholders to understand how processes are currently performed in practice.
• Document current-state ("as-is") processes, including responsibilities, systems, approvals and dependencies.
• Identify gaps, inconsistencies and opportunities to create clearer and more efficient ways of working.
• Develop practical future-state ("to-be") processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Create clear process documentation using tools such as Visio or PowerPoint.
• Ensure critical operational knowledge is properly captured and documented.
• Review and centralize existing supplier contracts, including ownership, expiry dates, renewal periods and key obligations.
• Review insurance arrangements and help identify potential gaps, overlaps or inconsistencies.
• Establish a practical approach for monitoring contract renewals, expiry dates and related actions.
• Collaborate with Procurement and Legal to ensure the appropriate contracts and governance are in place.
• Review and improve processes related to signing rights and delegated authorities.
• Take end-to-end ownership of deliverables and ensure the work progresses independently with limited day-to-day supervision.

• Demonstrated experience as a Business Process Consultant, Process Improvement Consultant, Business Operations Consultant or process-oriented Business Analyst.
• Strong hands-on experience with business process mapping and documentation.
• Able to conduct stakeholder interviews and translate complex information into clear and practical processes.
• Experience creating as-is/to-be process maps and SOPs.
• Previous exposure to contract management, supplier governance or operational governance is highly valuable.
• Strong analytical and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Autonomous and execution-focused: you are comfortable taking ownership and delivering the work from start to finish.
• Pragmatic and hands-on profile rather than purely strategic or advisory.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Fluent English, both written and spoken, is required.
• Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a strong advantage.

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety. 

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m. 
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

Our client is an established international banking institution operating in Luxembourg, a key European financial hub. The organisation combines a strong regulatory and risk management culture with an ambitious technology and digital transformation agenda. They are looking for a Head of IT based in Luxembourg. 

The organisation fosters collaboration between Technology, Risk, Compliance, Operations, Internal Audit, and Business teams, creating an environment where technology is viewed as a strategic enabler of growth, resilience, and operational excellence. The successful candidate will join a leadership team committed to strengthening governance, enhancing resilience frameworks, and supporting the bank's long-term transformation objectives.

As Head of IT, you will be responsible for defining and strengthening the local technology governance framework while ensuring alignment with business strategy, risk appetite, and Group Technology standards.

Key responsibilities include:

• Leading the local technology governance agenda and establishing effective governance committees, KPIs, KRIs, and reporting structures.
• Acting as the primary point of contact for technology-related matters involving the CSSF and coordinating regulatory responses, inspections, reviews, and remediation activities.
• Owning the local ICT risk management framework, including risk identification, assessment, reporting, mitigation planning, and ongoing monitoring.
• Providing clear and actionable technology risk reporting to senior management and governance bodies.
• Driving the implementation and continuous enhancement of DORA requirements and digital operational resilience capabilities.
• Overseeing ICT incident management processes, resilience testing, business continuity planning, and disaster recovery exercises.
• Managing third-party technology risks, including outsourced services, cloud environments, contractual obligations, information registers, and exit strategies.
• Monitoring technology service delivery, performance, capacity, control effectiveness, vulnerabilities, and resilience metrics.
• Coordinating internal and external audits while ensuring timely implementation of corrective actions.
• Collaborating closely with Business, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Group Technology stakeholders.
• Leading and developing the local technology team while promoting a strong governance, risk, and control culture.
• Supporting strategic technology initiatives, transformation programmes, and regulatory projects across the organisation.

The ideal candidate is an experienced technology leader with a strong background in technology governance, ICT risk management, and regulatory compliance within the financial services sector.

Key requirements include:

• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in technology leadership, governance, risk, or control-related functions.
• Proven experience within banking, financial services, or another highly regulated environment.
• Strong understanding of the Luxembourg regulatory landscape, particularly CSSF technology-related requirements.
• Demonstrated exposure to regulatory reviews, audits, supervisory inspections, and remediation programmes.
• Experience overseeing outsourced ICT services, cloud environments, and third-party technology providers.
• Strong knowledge of ICT risk management frameworks, operational resilience, cybersecurity governance, and DORA requirements.
• Ability to communicate complex technology and risk concepts to executive stakeholders in a concise and business-oriented manner.
• Experience working within matrix organisations and managing relationships across multiple stakeholder groups.
• University degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related discipline.
• Professional certifications such as CRISC, CISA, CGEIT, CISSP, ITIL, or ISO 27001 are considered a strong advantage.
• Fluent English & Spanish are mandatory, while French would be considered an asset.

Are you ready to shape the future of defense systems? Located in Liège, this opportunity offers a chance to lead groundbreaking advancements in system engineering. As Head of Systems Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in transforming complex defense technologies into modular, software-centric solutions that redefine industry standards. Join a dynamic sector where your expertise will drive progress and make an impact.

 

 

 

As the Head of Systems Engineering, you will be responsible for ensuring technical excellence across all aspects of system architecture, integration, industrialization, and lifecycle support. Your leadership will be instrumental in transitioning from product-focused operations to integrated, modular systems that prioritize execution and innovation. Key responsibilities include:

• System Architecture Mastery: Define and oversee reference architectures (mechanical, electronic, software, interfaces) while ensuring seamless integration between effectors, sensors, embedded software, connectivity, and lifecycle support requirements.
• Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Act as the de facto Head of System Engineering, making critical technical decisions across the portfolio and serving as the authority for programs, production teams, technology partners, and demanding military clients.
• Software & Robotic Systems Development: Establish software as a core industrial pillar by advancing practices in real-time robotics, control-command systems, safety-critical software, and cyber resilience. Promote simulation tools, digital twins, automated testing, and continuous integration tailored to high-stakes environments.
• Execution & Industrialization: Ensure architectural choices are scalable for mass production while maintaining cost efficiency. Collaborate closely with production departments, supply chain teams, quality assurance units, and lifecycle support experts to avoid prototype stagnation.
• Technological Partnerships: Drive strategic partnerships in areas such as sensors, counter-UAS systems, autonomy software, and more. Integrate external components seamlessly without compromising system integrity.

To excel in this role as Head of Systems Engineering - Robotics you should bring:

• Experience:
• 15+ years in engineering complex systems.
• Background in performance robotics (e.g., military/security robotics, drones/autonomous systems, critical industrial robotics).
• Proven track record in hardware/software integration, multi-disciplinary systems development, serial production implementation, and long lifecycle management within certified/safety-critical environments.
• Fluency in French and English is a must.
• Key Technical Skills:
• Expertise in system engineering with a holistic approach.
• Proficiency in mechatronic architectures, embedded electronics design, real-time software/middleware/communication frameworks.
• Deep understanding of trade-offs between performance vs. cost, sophistication vs. robustness, and innovation vs. industrialization.
• Leadership Qualities:
• Strategic technical leadership with decision-making authority.
• Ability to standardize processes and confidently say "no" when necessary.
• Comfortable navigating constrained industrial environments with exposure to demanding clients like armed forces.
• Credibility among senior engineers, program managers, and high-level technology partners.

Launched in 2017, 
mozzeno is a 100% Belgian digital lender that has established itself as a key player in the credit market.
 

Every day, we help individuals and businesses finance their projects through a simple, fast and fully digital process. Our strength? A unique blend of technology and human support, allowing us to deliver an efficient and personalised service.

In parallel, we give investors the opportunity to actively support the real economy in Belgium by financing the loans granted by mozzeno.
 

Based in 
Louvain-la-Neuve and currently experiencing strong growth, mozzeno is looking for an 
AI Automation Engineer to design, orchestrate and AI-augment our business processes.
 

Job content
 

As an AI Automation Engineer, you will design, build and maintain a portfolio of automation solutions that support mozzeno's teams and business processes — increasingly powered by AI.

Concretely, you will:
 
 

• Build automations with Python and PowerShell — scripts, integrations and services that connect our applications, move and transform data, and remove manual steps across the organisation. 

• Design and ship AI-powered workflows using Dify — our AI workflow platform — to orchestrate LLM-based steps (document processing, classification, extraction, drafting, internal assistants and agents) and embed them safely into our business processes. 

• Orchestrate end-to-end processes across our tools and systems — understanding how each application delivers part of the overall solution, and building the integrations and logic that make them work together reliably from one end to the other. 

• Develop functional expertise in our solution architecture, digging into the operational reality of each process to identify pain points and formulate solutions that genuinely improve the way we work. 

• Manage and get the most out of the external tools used by our teams, keeping them current, well-integrated and delivering real value. 
 

• You have a degree in computer science, or you are self-taught with tangible IT experience. 

• You are 
proficient in Python and PowerShell for automation, scripting and integration work — comfortable working with APIs, manipulating data, and building reliable, maintainable code. 

• You have a genuine interest in 
AI and LLMs, and ideally hands-on experience building workflows with 
Dify (or similar tools such as n8n, LangChain, Make, or comparable LLM-orchestration platforms). You are familiar with concepts such as 
prompting, RAG, embeddings, agentic workflows and tool/function calling, and understand how to put an LLM to work reliably inside a business process. 

• You are comfortable 
integrating and orchestrating systems through APIs, and think naturally about how tools and processes fit together end to end. 

• You are at ease in a 
cloud environment (Google, AWS). 

• You are naturally eager to learn the big picture, to dive into the functional and operational aspects of a business process, to understand the details and pain points, and to formulate solutions to improve them. 

• You have excellent problem-solving skills and can judge when to involve peers or experts. 

• You are detail-oriented, with strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks and projects at once. 

• You have excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to work with a range of stakeholders across the organisation. 

• You can work effectively in French & English, and Dutch is always an asset

You will contribute to the development and optimization of applications that support operations with real-time data & feedback. You will implement new features and improve existing modules within a modern frontend stack where performance, reliability, and usability are key.
You will also support the team with your technical expertise in Angular, helping maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability, and reusability. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, UX specialists, and product stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver robust and scalable enterprise applications.
